auditor_alex: Hi team — auditor here. For the ISO/SOC2 fieldwork we need evidence of our EKM integration and the recent RBAC changes that touched key access. Specifically: a) list of keys managed by the external KMS (IDs + regions), b) rotation history for the last 90 days, c) audit logs showing encrypt/decrypt and key-wrapping events (sample 2–3 events), and d) the change approvals/PRs for the RBAC updates that allowed service-account access. Can you confirm what you can provide and ETA? :eyes:

maria: Ack, I can own the bundle. Quick clarifying q: do you need cross-region key proof (we have keys in us-west-2 and eu-west-1) or just a sample per region? Also, do you want CloudTrail/Stackdriver raw events or an exported CSV?

auditor_alex: Prefer one sample per region + an aggregated CSV for the 90-day rotation list. Raw events are fine but a small sampling with context (resource ARNs, user/service principal, timestamp, event name) will help. Also need the RBAC PRs with reviewer approvals.

aj: FYI the EKM docs and runbook lives here: https://confluence.redwood/sec/ekm-integration (internal). For logs, use Splunk saved search "ekm_key_ops" or run this query: ```search index=cloudtrail eventName IN (Encrypt,Decrypt,GenerateDataKey,ReEncrypt) resourceType="kms" | fields _time, user, eventName, resourceARN, requestParameters | head 100``` That gets a compact sample.

sam_ops: Rotation facts: we rotate symmetric data keys monthly; envelope keys are rotated on request. For AWS KMS you can get versions with: ```aws kms list-keys --profile prod | jq '.Keys[]'``` and then ```aws kms list-key-versions --key-id <key>``` (we keep the rotation manifest in S3: s3://redwood-prod-security/ekm/rotation-manifests/). I can export a CSV of versions/timestamps.

maria: I'll gather: - per-region key manifest (IDs + friendly names) - 90-day rotation CSV - 3 raw audit events per region (CloudTrail JSON) - links to PRs/Jira for RBAC changes. I'll put artifacts into a presigned S3 folder and share. ETA EOD tomorrow.

auditor_alex: Thanks. For the RBAC evidence, can you include the list of service accounts that were granted kms:Decrypt and kms:Encrypt plus the approval matrix (who approved, ticket ID, date)?

devsec: PRs: https://git.redwood/sec-infra/pull/432 (grant ekm-access to service-account ekm-proxy) — approvals: @maria, @cloudinfra (approver list in PR). Jira: SEC-1987. Change window: 2026-01-04 02:00 UTC. Commit: a9c3f2d. I'll export the reviewer approval snapshots and sign-off comments.

maria: Added a small sample of the CloudTrail event we will include: ```{
  "eventTime": "2026-01-05T03:14:22Z",
  "eventName": "Decrypt",
  "userIdentity": {"type":"AWSService","invokedBy":"assumed-role/ekm-proxy"},
  "requestParameters": {"keyId":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:key/abcd-1234"},
  "resources": ["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:111222333:key/abcd-1234"]
}``` That will be in the raw JSON bundle along with the mapping to PR SEC-1987.

sam_ops: Note for auditor: we also have tamper-evident logs forwarded to our SIEM. If you want, I can pull the indexed event IDs and include a small verification manifest (hashes + timestamps) to show integrity.

auditor_alex: Yes please include the SIEM manifest. Also need confirmation of key custody — who holds the EKM admin role, and do we have emergency procedures (key revoke/rotation) documented?

maria: Custody: ekm-admin group (maria, devsec, sam_ops). Emergency playbook: https://confluence.redwood/sec/ekm-emergency-rotations (I'll include a PDF snapshot).

deploy-bot: deployment-bot: Deploy to prod completed for commit a9c3f2d at 2026-01-04T02:12:00Z :white_check_mark:

maria: Action items I have: 1) export rotation CSV + per-region manifests, 2) collect 3 sample CloudTrail events per region, 3) export PR approval snapshots and Jira ticket PDF, 4) SIEM integrity manifest. I will upload to s3://redwood-audit-deliverables/SEC-1987/ by 2026-01-28 EOD and share presigned links here.

auditor_alex: Great — that timeline works. If possible mark the evidence bundle with the ISO control mapping (ISO 27001:2013 A.10.1 / SOC2 CC6 mapping) so the reviewers can cross-check.

maria: Will do. Closing loop here once upload is done. Thanks everyone :pray:
